text:
lina: woke up to my config rewriting its semver to `v1.0.0-existential-crisis`. why does my YAML have feelings
omar: lol same. mine added `notes: 'pls validate me'` and a sad face emoji :pensive:
buildbot: lint-yaml: warning at config.yml:12: ambiguous indentation. Suggested remediation: offer therapy.
henry: poll: which is the true dark arts - semver shenanigans or mixing tabs and spaces in YAML? react :one: semver :two: tabs
lina: :one: semver lies sneak into prod, tabs blow up your local dev server silently
omar: favorite patch title i've seen recently: "chore: hold my beer while I fix whitespace" with diff:
```diff
- version: 2.0
+ version: 2.0-please-be-good
-    nested:
+  nested:
```
henry: also the coffee machine now has a sticker: "Indentation is self-care". seemed relevant
lina: conclusion: teach configs consent, and always run `make lint-yaml` before feelings get hurt :coffee:
